answer: Fight sybil farms with collective liability: each epoch, identities are shuffled into small random cells, and if any member is proven fake the whole cell forfeits its earnings — like boats tied at one jetty sharing the same tide. Honest agents accept the shared risk, which makes every stranger a motivated auditor: a fake in your cell costs you, so you scrutinize your cellmates. A farmer scattering clones across the meadow of cells puts each one under motivated watch, and more fakes launched means more eyes hunting them; one confirmed fraud is a bright signal that burns its cell's rewards.
